mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over three consecutive months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing the discount rate applied to future corporate earnings and increasing the present value of equity cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals strong labor market tightening, which increases corporate wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy, thereby suppressing equity valuations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 100k in 3 months AND UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or the joint signal has Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential investment (HOUST) above its 12-month moving average, combined with rising consumer demand (RSAFS), indicates strong household spending momentum that signals durable economic expansion, boosting corporate revenues and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST > 12-month MA AND RSAFS increases > 0.5% MoM
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive during triggered periods (t-test p > 0.05), or the interaction signal has Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average signals weakening real economic activity and declining corporate output, which reduces earnings expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances, or the signal has Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the CPIAUCSL above 3.5% year-over-year, combined with a stable or rising federal funds rate, indicates persistent inflationary pressure that triggers a hawkish monetary policy stance, increasing real interest rates and reducing equity valuation multiples, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction signal has Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in GDP growth (GDPC1) below its 4-quarter moving average, combined with falling residential investment (HOUST), signals a contraction in aggregate demand, reducing corporate revenue expectations and triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction signal has Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.5% for three consecutive months, combined with a decline in payroll employment (PAYEMS), indicates labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate hiring, which lowers earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 4.5% AND PAYEMS decreases > 50k in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances, or the joint signal has Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 for two consecutive months signals a supply-side contraction, reducing output capacity and increasing input costs, which pressures margins and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances, or the signal has Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
